default.speaker: Detective Solid
default.text: Fog's rolling thick off the bay tonight. Someone left a mark on Sanke, and we're going to find out who before sunrise.

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Rain's hammering that red-striped awning, pooling nice and deep along the stone path. Inside looks warm through the glass, almost cozy. Too bad Sanke's stretched out unconscious in the alley with the medics hovering over him.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: Docs say he'll make it, Solid. But we've got maybe thirty minutes before his crew loses their nerve and bolts into the woods. After that, the trail's cold.

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Then let's skip the small talk under the canopy. Check the patio before you touch that front door.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: Wet patio. Chairs, tables, glass door with rain streaming down. What exactly am I looking at?

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: The puddles, Akens. Look at the tail-drag threading through every single one of them -- straight from that door, around the corner, toward the alley. Sanke walked out under his own power. Nobody dragged him out here.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: So he knew whoever jumped him. You're saying he strolled into an alley in this weather on purpose?

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Or he wasn't expecting trouble. Case in point: the stray cat sitting on the fence all night. Didn't make a peep.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: The alley cat? That mangy thing screams at passing shadows. I've lost sleep over it.

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Exactly. Yet it slept peacefully through the silent stabbing not twenty feet away. Quick strike, sharp blade, zero struggle. Whoever did this was calm and knew Sanke well.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: And no weapon left behind. Medics said his scales were clean. Killer took the knife with them.

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Or stashed it close. Look at the glass by the front door, tucked under the overhang where the rain missed. Fresh claw scratches. Someone wanted us to see 'em.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: A puzzle left behind? The guy's practically taunting us over a homicide.

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: Naturally. Arrogance always leaves fingerprints. Let's crack this morning puzzle and see how smart our culprit really is.

morning_intro.speaker: Akens
morning_intro.text: Thirty minutes on the clock and we're reading scratch marks on a door. Where do we start?

morning_intro.speaker: Detective Solid
morning_intro.text: With the details everyone else stepped right over.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: Afternoon sun's cutting through the front glass, kicking up dust and the smell of truffle oil. Akens, what'd you find in the kitchen?

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Akens
afternoon_interrogation.text: More scratch marks by the back door, and a fresh shed snake skin behind the flour sacks. Whoever dropped that skin was shaking in their scales. We're getting nowhere fast, Solid. I think we're being led in circles.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: Let's straighten those circles out. Hand me my pipe first; I think better when I'm burning tobacco. Now, about that skin -- look at the dorsal ridge and ventral count. That didn't drop off any ordinary local.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Kanes
afternoon_interrogation.text: Enough! You two clumping around my dining room like tax auditors! And put that pipe out -- this is an eatery, not a smoking lounge! Molting is what snakes do, it proves nothing!

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: They molt when they grow, Mr. Kanes. And they molt when sheer terror hits 'em. Finding a shed skin behind flour sacks hours after your best friend gets shanked? That's not routine.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Kanes
afternoon_interrogation.text: You're wasting time suspecting me! If we waste any more, the crew's going to scatter into the woods! Isn't that what you cops are always whining about -- the clock?

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: Funny thing about clocks, Akens. Mr. Kanes can tell us down to the second how much time we're wasting, but he's awfully hazy on where he was when Sanke took that knife.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Akens
afternoon_interrogation.text: Asked him that myself. Claims he was outside smoking on the patio. Only problem? The patio ashtray was dry, and it poured rain all night.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Kanes
afternoon_interrogation.text: I came inside when the storm picked up, like any sane person! Since when is dry shelter a felony?!

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: Staying dry is fine, Kanes. But your tail's been twitching like a trapped beetle every time we bring up Sanke, and it goes quiet whenever we mention the back cellar.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Kanes
afternoon_interrogation.text: Nervous tic! Runs in my mother's family! Ask any physician in town! And keep my mustache out of your notebook, detective!

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: Noted. Now, let's talk about the blade. Clean cut, but Sanke's blood has traces of paralytic venom in it. Coated. Someone knew exact dosages.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Akens
afternoon_interrogation.text: Wait. Tonics, tenderizers, numbing agents... kitchen's stocked with that stuff right by the back door. Oh man.

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Kanes
afternoon_interrogation.text: Slander! Get out of my restaurant! Eleven years I've fed this city! I'll have the health inspector on you -- he's my cousin's in-law!

afternoon_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
afternoon_interrogation.text: File all the complaints you want, Kanes. Your handwriting might just be our best exhibit. Now let's tackle that back door puzzle before my patience runs out.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: Solid... amico... you made it. Freezing back here against these stone walls. Pull up a chair, keep it down.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: Easy, old friend. The docs say you'll coil again. Just sip your tonic and give me the essentials.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: It wasn't robbery. He smiled when he walked up. I recognized the face from old business -- manifests and ledgers I should've torched years ago. God, I see it now.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: Take a breath. Give me a name.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: Names got me carved up. Here's something better: when your deputies rushed the front, he bolted through the kitchen and out the back door into the alley. Something dropped from his coat as he ran. Sounded like metal hitting stone.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: What was it? The blade? A key?

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: A letter. Wrapped in oilskin. The Emerald Fang syndicate, our killer, smuggling records -- everything in writing, with two different handwritings in the margins. One of 'em I'd know blindfolded.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Akens
evening_interrogation.text: The Emerald Fang! Solid, if we find that letter, we bust this whole ring wide open!

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: Then find it before time runs out. The Fang doesn't leave loose threads, and neither does he. One of you is racing the clock.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: Then we'll be faster. Akens -- comb the alley from fence to door. Every brick, every barrel.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Akens
evening_interrogation.text: Here! A flagstone wobbles by the fence -- got an oilskin packet wedged underneath. Smells like laudanum. But it's locked up tight with some cipher puzzle.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: Naturally. He knew we'd trace him here. One last puzzle, Akens -- his personal vault.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Sanke
evening_interrogation.text: His rattle... I heard his rattle right before the knife came down. Sharp and quick, like an old pocket watch winding.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Detective Solid
evening_interrogation.text: Only one snake in this town has a rattle like a dying watch. Solve the puzzle, Akens, and we bag the letter, the ring, and the Fang.

evening_interrogation.speaker: Akens
evening_interrogation.text: Clock's almost dead and I can hear the crew rustling in the woods. Let's finish this.

time_penalty_warning.speaker: Akens
time_penalty_warning.text: Damn it, Solid! That mistake just cost us five minutes! The clock's slipping away!

time_penalty_warning.speaker: Detective Solid
time_penalty_warning.text: Five minutes is gone. Stop staring at the watch and look at what we've got left.

time_penalty_warning.speaker: Kanes
time_penalty_warning.text: Hear that?! Five minutes wasted! The crew's looking at the treeline right now while you two stand around!

time_penalty_warning.speaker: Akens
time_penalty_warning.text: Funny how you always know exactly how much time is left, Kanes. Keep rattling; we're logging every second.

time_penalty_warning.speaker: Detective Solid
time_penalty_warning.text: Knock it off, both of you. He's trying to rattle our nerves. Keep moving.

time_expired.speaker: Detective Solid
time_expired.text: Thirty minutes. Done. Hear that? Snap of branches, fading footsteps, pouring rain. They panicked and melted into the dark forest. We lost them, Akens.

time_expired.speaker: Akens
time_expired.text: Lost them? After Sanke's word, the shed skin, the ciphers? For nothing?

time_expired.speaker: Detective Solid
time_expired.text: Not for nothing. Evidence washes away, but facts stay put. Everything we dug up is in your notebook, and notebooks don't run into the woods.

time_expired.speaker: Akens
time_expired.text: So we get another shot at them?

time_expired.speaker: Detective Solid
time_expired.text: Hope and a stubborn memory. Somewhere out there, a cold-blooded killer thinks he's won. Let him. I don't lose twice.

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: With that letter out from under the flagstone, the whole picture snaps together. Look at the syndicate papers next to the suspect's handwriting. Stroke for stroke: the cramped letters, the crossed t's, the loop on every signature.

ending_1_true.speaker: Akens
ending_1_true.text: It's him! The ledgers, the oilskin, the shed skin behind the flour. Cuff him, Solid!

ending_1_true.speaker: Kanes
ending_1_true.text: You can't prove a scale of it! It's a forged conspiracy! I want a dozen lawyers and a public inquiry!

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: Ask for a bench of judges, Kanes. Won't save you. When you rule out the impossible -- the forged syndicate signature, the dry ashtray, the venom pulled straight from your own kitchen -- whatever's left is the truth. And it's pointing right at you.

ending_1_true.speaker: Kanes
ending_1_true.text: I only kept the books! The Emerald Fang had a knife to my throat! Sanke was going to burn the manifests and sink us all!

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: So you knifed your oldest friend behind his own kitchen and left riddles in the dirt to stroke your own ego. Vanity always brings 'em down.

ending_1_true.speaker: Akens
ending_1_true.text: Medics are getting Sanke on the stretcher. Color's returning. He's gonna pull through.

ending_1_true.speaker: Sanke
ending_1_true.text: Told you... the Fang leaves no loose ends. Neither do you, detective. My testimony is yours. New Portland's sleeping safe tonight.

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: Rest up, Sanke. The courts can handle the rest.

ending_1_true.speaker: Akens
ending_1_true.text: Rain's finally easing up. Sun's hitting the treetops. Fitting, right?

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: Save the poetry for your notebook, Akens. We've got a bookkeeper to jail and a syndicate to dismantle.

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: We've got their ledgers and their couriers are flying blind. Let 'em run. I'll hunt 'em down one by one.

ending_1_true.speaker: Akens
ending_1_true.text: Not bad for a cold-blooded cop.

ending_1_true.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_1_true.text: Just good police work. Buy a fresh notebook; we've got work to do.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: We missed the letter. Without proof of the syndicate, the courts won't hold the killer. No judge is convicting on a dry ashtray and a twitchy tail.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Akens
ending_2_fallback.text: So we just let them walk? All that work, gone?

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: We pin it on the collective. It's messy and the real killer slips into the fog, but someone's taking the fall.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Kanes
ending_2_fallback.text: All of us?! You're hauling the whole crew in on a technicality?!

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: A technicality is what keeps justice from being a lynching. Be grateful.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Akens
ending_2_fallback.text: Constables are packing 'em into the van. Half are crying, half are swearing revenge.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: Let 'em swear. Desperate crooks talk before trial. One of 'em will crack.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: He knows the truth even if the paper's missing. That letter is still out there waiting.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Akens
ending_2_fallback.text: The mastermind is still breathing out in the dark. That's gonna bug me.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: Then put that insomnia to work. Tomorrow we tear those smuggling rings apart. Shadows can't run forever.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Akens
ending_2_fallback.text: You're awfully chipper for a guy whose case just fell apart.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: I haven't lost. I've just been made to wait. The truth is patient. It knows I'm coming.

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Kanes
ending_2_fallback.text: This isn't over! The Fang protects its own!

ending_2_fallback.speaker: Detective Solid
ending_2_fallback.text: Then it'll be a good lesson for both of us. Grab your coat, Akens. We've got all the time in the world.
